wind_bed.text: Cold thin high-altitude wind blowing steadily across a remote empty Himalayan glacier valley, airy and distant, no gusts too loud, no voices, no birds

avalanche_rumble.text: Deep distant rumble of a massive rock and ice avalanche collapsing far away in high mountains, heavy low-frequency roar building and rolling

stylus_scratch.text: Close quiet mechanical scratching of a seismograph pen stylus on a slowly rotating paper drum, faint motor hum

flood_roar.text: Sustained violent roar of a flash flood of mud, boulders and churning water crashing through a narrow rocky mountain gorge, heavy deep rumble at constant full intensity, relentless, no fade

tick.text: Single soft muted wooden tick, subtle interface click

card_snap.text: Soft paper card snapping down flat onto a desk, subtle and dry

card_flip.text: Quick soft paper card flip, dry

marker_strokes.text: Two quick bold felt marker pen strokes on paper, swish swish

whoosh.text: Soft airy cinematic whoosh, gentle and short

plink_cascade.text: Rapid cascade of many tiny soft glassy plinks, like light raindrops on glass, gentle and quiet

sonar_ping.text: Single soft low sonar ping with a gentle fading echo

dark_drone.text: Low ominous cinematic synth drone swelling up slowly, dark and quiet

lock_clunk.text: Heavy iron padlock and chain clunking shut against an old wooden door, close

title_boom.text: Deep soft cinematic low boom impact with a long dark reverb tail, understated

river_rush.text: Steady rushing of a fast glacial mountain river over rocks in a deep gorge, constant medium intensity, heard from a little distance, no birds, no voices

debris_churn.text: Heavy wet churning of mud, gravel and boulders grinding and tumbling together in a thick debris flow, deep rumbling, constant intensity, no voices

slurry_pour.text: Close thick wet concrete slurry sliding and slopping heavily down a steel chute, viscous gloopy pour, low and wet

train_pass.text: Fast express passenger train passing by at speed on rails, doppler whoosh with rhythmic wheel clatter, short pass-by, no horn

drum_hit.text: A single sharp loud open-palm hit on a traditional Indian dhol drum, a loud crack that decays almost instantly, dry and punchy

cupboard_drag.text: A heavy iron cupboard being dragged slowly across a bare concrete floor, a long low scraping metallic screech, continuous and effortful

reveal_chime.text: A single soft bright bell chime with a short clean ring and a little sparkle, quiet and understated, not celebratory

water_trickle.text: Gentle trickling and soft lapping of meltwater slowly filling a still mountain pool, quiet and continuous, no birds

dam_break.text: A loose earthen and rock dam cracking and bursting open, a heavy crumbling crack followed by a rushing surge of water breaking through debris

broom_sweep.text: Three brisk strokes of a dry grass broom sweeping dust and small pebbles across a cement floor, close, dry scratchy swish

scan_sweep.text: Soft electronic scanning sweep, a smooth rising digital hum with faint data blips, subtle interface sound

scissors_snip.text: A single crisp snip of heavy brass scissors closing, sharp metallic

metal_clank.text: Small brass scissors bouncing off a hard glass surface, one bright metallic clank

drawer_slide.text: A wooden cabinet drawer sliding open smoothly on old runners

drawer_slam.text: A heavy wooden cabinet drawer slammed shut, one solid thud with a small rattle

bead_clatter.text: Small glass beads rolling and clicking together into a neat line on a hard surface

bead_click.text: One small glass bead clicking into place, tiny and crisp

msg_pop.text: A soft friendly phone message notification pop

coin_stack.text: Coins being stacked quickly on a wooden table, light metallic clinks

stopwatch_tick.text: A mechanical stopwatch ticking quickly, close and dry

shop_shutter.text: A metal shop shutter rolling up in the morning, rattling

desert_wind_bed.text: Hot dry desert wind, soft and steady, faint distant insects, wide open space, no birds, no voices

harbor_bed.text: Cold grey harbour, small waves slapping a wooden fishing boat, distant gulls, steady
